label: Cold Exit player — clip selection (Phase 1: replicates player.js:1695-1737 exactly)
_phase1Note: Phase 1 ports the existing if/else cascade verbatim. Future phases (graph.js + bone_mask.js) will add layers + per-bone masks + true blending; for now this is a flat priority list of single-clip states, evaluated top-down with first-match-wins. Speed-driven timeScale lives on the state via speedRef; the evaluator returns it alongside the clip name.
_inputsNote: The evaluator is given an `inputs` object derived from playerState. Inputs used here: swinging, crouched, moving, running, aim. See src/anim/state_machine.js#deriveInputs for the mapping from playerState → inputs.
